name: cloudplatform
description: A personal cloud platform control centre

scripts.build: npm run build -w @cloud/shared && npm run build -w @cloud/api && npm run build -w @cloud/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build -w @cloud/shared && npm run build -w @cloud/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @cloud/shared && npm run build -w @cloud/web
scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @cloud/api & npm run dev -w @cloud/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @cloud/shared && npm run typecheck -w @cloud/api && npm run typecheck -w @cloud/web
